paite: TOUPA athupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi, i Pathian khopi ah, atang siangthou ah.
heading: Korah Tate La / Pathian Khopi Zion

paite: Asandan a kilawm, leitung tengteng kipahna, Zion tang ahi, mallam pang a, Kumpipa thupitak khopi.
A-inpi ah Pathian in insang ahihdan akitheisak hi.
Ngai in, kumpipate akikhawm ua, apaikhawmta uhi.
Amu ua, huchi in lamdang asa ua; amangbang ua, apaimang pah uhi.
Huai ah linna in aman a; numei nauvei natna in amat lai bang in.
Suahlam huih in Tarshish long liante ana hihse zel hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA khopi ah, i Pathian khopi ah, bil a i zak bangtak in i muta; Pathian in huai khopi tangtawn a ding in ahihkip ding. Selah
Pathian aw, na tempul sunggil ah na zahngaihna ka ngaihtuahta uhi.
Pathian aw, na min bang ngei in na phatna kawlmong pha in a-om a; na khut taklam diktatna in adim hi.
Na vaihawmnate ziak in Zion tang kipaktak in om henla, Judah tanute nuam in om uhen.
Zion kim ah, akimvel in pai unla; agalven insangte leng sim un.
Akulhte chiamteh hoih unla, a-inpite ngaihtuah un; khang hong om nawnte a na hilhtheihna ding un.
Hiai Pathian tangtawn tangtawn a i Pathian hi ding ahi a, sih tanpha a leng hon pipa ahi ding hi.
